U1.note: HJSIP HJ-840 LGA64 6.2 x 7.0 x 1.0, JLC stock about 90, integrated antenna (A7 ANT bridged to A8 BOARD_ANT by a top-layer track, net ANT), HIGH-VOLTAGE mode: VDDH = VBAT, VDD pins H3/H4 = the 3V3 rail supplied by the module regulator REG0 (UICR REGOUT0 must be set to 3.3 V once, default 1.8 V; flash with 3.3 V on both the cell + pad and the SWD 3V3 pad = normal-voltage mode); DCCH, DEC1, DEC5, DECUSB not connected (module has its own filter capacitors; DC/DC off, LDO mode: VERIFY with figure 2.4 of the manual); NFC pins not used; no parts under the module, no copper in the antenna area

C70.note: 3V3 = nRF52840 REG0 output: 4.7 uF at VDD H3/H4 (review C3); HV mode relies on REG0, max 25 mA external at TX <= 4 dBm (nRF52840 PS v1.7 p.84 via DevZone, verify)

Q1.note: reverse-polarity protection of the cell (review H6): drain on the cell +, source on VBAT, gate on GND. Correct cell: body diode, then the channel (Vgs = -VBAT) conducts; reversed cell: off. RDS(on) 85 mohm at Vgs -2.5 V (60 at -4.5): about 60 mV at the 0.7 A boost peak. Charging (21 mA) flows source -> drain through the on channel. JLC basic part. SOT-23 1 G 2 S 3 D

JU1.note: JLC-stocked (2143) HRO sink-board 16P USB-C receptacle in a 9.4 x 6.7 mm notch of the +Y edge (+ 6.6 x 0.7 sub-notch), centre x 23.5; pads = the official LCSC/HRO land pattern (12 SMD pads in one row, merged power pads, 4 shield THT slots, 2 peg holes); SBU pads A8/B8 not connected; pin check 2026-11-20 (cup/PIN-CHECK.md); height vs lid inner z 7.6 and cell top 4.1: mechanics VERIFY

U7A.note: single H-bridge for coil A, VM 0-11 V, VCC 1.8-7 V, 1.8 A peak; pins (TI SLVSBA4F rev F, DSG package): 1 VM, 2 OUT1, 3 OUT2, 4 GND, 5 EN, 6 PH, 7 nSLEEP = MOT_ALLOW (review M2 2026-11-24: asleep, 5 nA, whenever the hardware enable is low; awake 300 uA only while the motor may run; wake-up 30 us, the firmware waits settle_ms = 10 ms after the enable), 8 VCC, pad GND; no current sense or limit: the current is set by the coil resistance; the hardware cut stays in the load switch U20 on VMOT

U7B.note: single H-bridge for coil B, VM 0-11 V, VCC 1.8-7 V, 1.8 A peak; pins (TI SLVSBA4F rev F, DSG package): 1 VM, 2 OUT1, 3 OUT2, 4 GND, 5 EN, 6 PH, 7 nSLEEP = MOT_ALLOW (review M2 2026-11-24: asleep, 5 nA, whenever the hardware enable is low; awake 300 uA only while the motor may run; wake-up 30 us, the firmware waits settle_ms = 10 ms after the enable), 8 VCC, pad GND; no current sense or limit: the current is set by the coil resistance; the hardware cut stays in the load switch U20 on VMOT

C19.note: VCC bypass of U7A (datasheet: 0.1 uF at VCC)

C20.note: VCC bypass of U7B (datasheet: 0.1 uF at VCC)

LD1.note: top-facing status RGB LED under the clear lid, common anode through ONE 1k from VBAT (GPIO high = off even at 4.2 V, no idle current); one lit channel about 0.7 to 1.7 mA; pad order and common anode (pin 4) verified in the vendor drawing; green and blue VF 2.8 to 3.4 V: dim below about 3.4 V cell voltage

SW1.note: top face at (46.5, 22.05), pressed by the printed plunger; pads 1+3 / 2+4 are the two contacts (Alps)

BZ1.note: fitted: 4 x 4 x 2.0 mm SMD magnetic sounder on the bottom side of the side_b block (2.0 mm part, 4.3 mm free below the board, 2.3 mm spare), pod position about (39.0, 20.2), z 3.3 to 5.3; driven by QBA + D6, off by default; vendor data: 4 kHz square wave 2 to 4 Vp, rated 3 V / max 90 mA, coil 17 ohm, MIN 65 dB at 10 cm (drive with PWM at 4 kHz, never DC: 4.2 V / 17 ohm = 0.25 A); alternatives MLT-5020 C94598 (5 x 5), Cy-SMD-4020-3040 C968744

D6.note: flyback across the sounder coil (cathode pad 1 on VBAT)

RBZ.note: series resistor of the sounder (review m4): coil 17 +-3 ohm (vendor), 4.2 V / (17 + 22 + about 3 ohm) = 100 mA peak, vendor maximum 90 mA at 3 V; 0.1 W 0603 at 50 % duty, alarm bursts only; flyback D6 across the coil only

TPR1.note: 0.6 mm bare pad on the underside of the hall finger at 1.27 mm pitch: first SWD flash (pogo clip / JLC programming) and recovery, both variants

TPR2.note: 0.6 mm bare pad on the underside of the hall finger at 1.27 mm pitch: first SWD flash (pogo clip / JLC programming) and recovery, both variants

TPR3.note: 0.6 mm bare pad on the underside of the hall finger at 1.27 mm pitch: first SWD flash (pogo clip / JLC programming) and recovery, both variants

TPR4.note: 0.6 mm bare pad on the underside of the hall finger at 1.27 mm pitch: first SWD flash (pogo clip / JLC programming) and recovery, both variants

TPS1.note: 0.6 mm bare top-side pad: supervisor PA13 SWDIO for an SWD probe (connect under reset); the nRF must hold BPHASE / SUP_BOOT0 as inputs (high-Z) while a probe is attached

TPS2.note: 0.6 mm bare top-side pad: supervisor PA14 SWCLK for an SWD probe (connect under reset); the nRF must hold BPHASE / SUP_BOOT0 as inputs (high-Z) while a probe is attached

TPS3.note: 0.6 mm bare top-side pad: supervisor NRST for an SWD probe (connect under reset); the nRF must hold BPHASE / SUP_BOOT0 as inputs (high-Z) while a probe is attached

U30.note: independent supervisor (INTERLOCK.md H, I); UFQFPN20 pin map from DS13866 rev 5 table 12 (pin check 2026-11-20: the earlier TSSOP20 numbering was wrong on this package): 19 PB7 MCU_EN, 20 PC14 SUP_DONE, 1 PC15 SUP_WAKE, 2 VDD, 3 VSS, 4 NRST, 5 PA0 ARM_CLK, 6 PA1 APHASE, 7 PA2 MOT_FWD, 8 PA3 OC_OK, 10 PA5 SUP_PERMIT, 11 PA6 SUP_OK, 12 PA7 NRST(nRF), 14 PA11 TXD (bootloader USART1 TX), 15 PA12 RXD, 16 PA13 BPHASE (SWDIO at reset, pull-up), 17 PA14-BOOT0 (internal pull-down at reset), 18 PB6 DOCK_N; no exposed pad; BOOT0 pin only effective when option bit nBOOT_SEL = 0 (blank part boots the system loader through the empty-flash check)

C81.note: bypass shared by the latch U6 and the XOR U33

C82.note: bypass shared by the AND3 U36 and the TPL5010 U5

U5.note: independent timer now watches the SUPERVISOR: no DONE after WAKE -> RSTn low: resets the supervisor and clears the latch

R26.note: TPL5010 interval resistor: 6.79 kohm = 2 s (SNAS651A table 3), 1 %; 10 k would give about 7.6 s (review C1)

U6.note: interlock latch: set by an ARM_CLK edge, cleared by LATCH_CLR_N (power-up, TPL5010 timeout, supervisor reset, over-current)

U32.note: LATCH_CLR_N = SUP_NRST AND OC_OK: any supervisor reset / TPL5010 timeout or an over-current trip clears the latch (no diodes)

R16.note: forward-intent line pull-up: default = forward = blocked when undocked

QBA.note: sounder drive leg (100 k pull-down RDA), off by default

U33.note: DOCK_XOR = DOCK_N XOR MOT_FWD = DOCKED XOR DIR_REVERSE (DOCK_N is active low, MOT_FWD high = forward): docked+forward and undocked+reverse allowed, undocked+forward and docked+reverse (H15) blocked; reset default MOT_FWD high (R16) = forward = blocked when undocked; JLC stock 3001 (review C2)

U36.note: PERM_L = LATCH_Q AND SUP_PERMIT AND MCU_EN (review M1: CLAUDE.md rule motor only with MCU enable AND watchdog in hardware); 74AUP1G11 pinout 1 A 2 GND 3 B 4 Y 5 VCC 6 C (LCSC symbol); the SC-70-6 74AUP1G11GW has JLC stock 3, this DFN-6 1.0 x 1.45 clone has 9000

U34.note: MOT_ALLOW = LATCH_Q AND SUP_PERMIT AND MCU_EN AND (DOCKED XOR reverse): the single hardware enable of the load switch (pure logic, no software)

RDK.note: SPICE F1: pull-up on the hall output so an open hall joint reads UNDOCKED (a floating low line would read docked and enable forward undocked)

RNR.note: SPICE F5: pull-up for the open-drain TPL5010 RSTn (the STM32C011 NRST weak pull-up is not relied on)

C61.note: SPICE F6: 0.1 uF at the VM pin of U7A (datasheet requirement) in addition to the bulk C21

C62.note: 0.1 uF at the VM pin of U7B (datasheet requirement)

C71.note: SPICE F3: second 10 uF at the TPS61023 VIN (boost pre-charge dip), next to U8

U20.note: current-limited high-side switch 2.5-6.5 V, 85 mohm, EN active high (hardware cut), FAULT open drain = OC_OK (low when the limit is active > deglitch), NOT the -1 latch variant; WSON-6 2x2 (DRV, 0.8 mm: fits the underside) pinout 1 OUT 2 ILIM 3 FAULT 4 EN 5 GND 6 IN, PowerPAD = GND, verified in the TI datasheet table 5-1 (2026-11-20 layout review)

R91.note: ILIM resistor 47k: TI table 49.9k = 475/520/565 mA, from the TPS2553 equations (SLVS841G eq. 1-3) 47 k gives 506/557/616 mA (min/typ/max): above the worst-case motor current 0.40 A (5 V, 23.9 ohm coil, 1 ohm bridge), well below the 1.5 A bridge rating

R57.note: VMOT sense divider 10k/10k = also the bleeder of the VM capacitors (time constant about 0.6 s), reads 2.5 V at 5 V

U8.note: sync boost 3.7 A switch, 0.5-5.5 V in, 1 uA off, about 90 % at 0.3 A out; VIN from the cell, EN = SUP_PERMIT (supervisor second cut); pinout verified in SLVSF14B: 1 FB 2 EN 3 VIN 4 GND 5 SW 6 VOUT; output OVP 5.7 V typ

L1.note: 1 uH 2.5 x 2.0 x 1.2; Isat VERIFY >= 2.5 A

CB1.note: bulk on the boost output (basic part, 25 V rated per JLC); about 8 uF effective at 5 V DC bias

U10.note: 3D hall, I2C 0x35, on the board top at the rear-far corner, off-axis to the pinion magnet (y 33.435) through the plastic wall; pin 3 = GND(TEST), pin 5 INT# not used

SW2.note: Alps detector switch on the tongue underside, lever toward +x (head); N/O: closed = adapter locked (the d2 pin behind the 2 mm ball pushes the lever); open / broken = DOCK_N high = not locked = forward blocked (RDK); pads 3 / 4 = frame legs, no net

RLK.note: series resistor switch -> DOCK_N: with RDK 100 k the closed switch gives 0.3 V (AUP VIL 0.9 V); open RLK reads not locked

CLK.note: debounce: switch closes -> DOCK_N falls with 0.9 ms (RLK || RDK), opens -> rises with 10 ms (RDK), about 8 ms to VIH 2.0 V; to 3V3, not GND: a shorted capacitor reads NOT locked (fail safe)

J2.note: NFP-608-26.45-SGM lead connector 'JST 1.25 pitch' (family not stated by NFP: PicoBlade-compatible ASSUMED), A+, A-, B+, B- on 1-4 (phase sequence of the NFP datasheet; check the lead order on the motor before the first run); bottom face, opening toward -x; the two mounting tabs MP on GND

J3.note: bare cell leads (Ampul 301030, red + / black -) pressed into the IDC (26-28 AWG, insulation 0.7-1.0 mm), no soldering; bottom face near the front edge, wires along x from the front edge; + / - marked on the bottom silkscreen
